description_en: Retrieves a list of normalization rule versions
description_zh: 获取标准化规则版本列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-rule-versions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-rule-id nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationRuleVersions

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat detection and response data management center resides. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets reside in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets reside outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required in actual calls. If this parameter is not specified, the service returns a 400 error "The specified Lang can not be empty." Explicitly pass in the language code
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：此参数在实际调用中为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误 “The specified Lang can not be empty.”，请显式传入语言代码
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the view of another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
